Our food and beverage team is able to cater any event and assist in making your day memorable. Please feel free to get in touch with any specific requests. services.desc: Explore our range of cabins designed to accommodate groups of all sizes, each boasting a full bath and picturesque river views. Ideal for those seeking a serene retreat, our rustic cabins provide added comfort with amenities like plush beds, private restrooms, and climate control, ensuring a great stay along the banks of the Potomac River. Please review the information at the bottom of this page for important details about the Harpers Ferry and how to make the most out of your stay! If you are planning accommodations for up to 6 guests, the Harpers Ferry Campground also offers 6-person DELUXE cabins!
